feed.title: enterpriseai.tools weekly updates — gateways
feed.subtitle: High-impact market intelligence for enterprise AI tooling, with an expandable release log for lower-signal product changes.

entry.title: Unity Gateway supports bring-your-own ChatGPT for Codex
entry.summary: Codex and the ChatGPT desktop app can run on a user's own ChatGPT Go, Plus, Pro or Enterprise plan through Unity Gateway. Usage bills to that subscription while Unity Gateway governs access.

entry.title: Kong AI Gateway patches cache, SAML and SQL flaws
entry.summary: Kong AI Gateway 2.2.1 stops four cache plugins caching authenticated responses, enforces the SAML audience restriction (CVE-2026-92439) and fixes SQL escaping in LLM usage counters (CVE-2026-92544). 2.3.1 applies nginx security patches.

entry.title: Kong AI Gateway 2.3 adds Cedar policies and Token Vault
entry.summary: Kong AI Gateway 2.3.0 adds a Cedar-based access-policy-engine plugin, Token Vault plugins, dynamic model pricing and Baseten support. Breaking: the NeMo guardrail auth prefix default is now empty and GraphQL cache_control defaults to true.

entry.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway adds model aliases
entry.summary: Cloudflare AI Gateway model aliases let an app call one name that maps to a pool of models, trying them in order with fallback or smart routing. Aliases can change without redeploying the app.

entry.title: New Cloudflare AI Gateways require authentication
entry.summary: New Cloudflare AI Gateways now have authentication on by default, and it cannot be turned off once enabled; requests to disable it return HTTP 400. Existing gateways without authentication keep working.

entry.title: AI Functions spend now counts toward Unity Gateway budgets
entry.summary: From November 1, 2026, Unity Gateway budgets include spend from task-specific AI Functions such as ai_parse_document, ai_extract and ai_classify, in both batch and real-time execution.

entry.title: agentgateway 1.7 encrypts MCP sessions by default
entry.summary: agentgateway 1.7.0 always encrypts MCP sessions in standalone mode (older sessions are rejected), extends prompt guards to tool outputs by default, and blocks dynamic backends from reaching loopback and link-local addresses such as cloud metadata.

entry.title: Unity Gateway usage dashboard tracks coding-agent spend
entry.summary: The Unity Gateway Usage Dashboard v1.0 adds coding-agent adoption, harness usage, estimated session spend, model and user spend analysis, and tag-based spend attribution. GPT-6.1 Terra also became available the same day.

entry.title: Unity Gateway configures Claude and ChatGPT desktop agents
entry.summary: The Unity Gateway CLI can now configure Claude desktop and ChatGPT desktop work agents with governed models, MCP servers and skills. Subscription relay is available only in Claude desktop.

entry.title: Unity Gateway screens MCP tool calls for jailbreaks
entry.summary: Unity Gateway can now screen MCP tool calls and their results for jailbreak and prompt-injection attempts in beta, with the Jailbreak guardrail applied to input, output or both.

entry.title: Cloudflare AI provider packages deprecated for createAI
entry.summary: Cloudflare feature-froze and deprecated workers-ai-provider and ai-gateway-provider. The Agents SDK createAI replaces them, covering Workers AI, AI Gateway catalog models, dynamic routes and vendor models.

entry.title: Unity Gateway consumer access is GA
entry.summary: Users with the consumer access entitlement no longer need an account admin to enable a preview before querying shared model services through Unity Gateway. Admins can still set budgets and rate limits.

entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon added to Unity Gateway
entry.summary: Google Gemini 4 Argon is available on Databricks Unity Gateway through Foundation Model APIs.

entry.title: Kong Gateway 3.16.0.1 adds A2A v1.0 in AI Gateway
entry.summary: Kong Gateway 3.16.0.1 adds the A2A v1.0 wire format to ai-a2a-proxy alongside v0.3, prompt cache-control mappings for OpenAI, Anthropic and Bedrock in ai-proxy-advanced, and several routing and telemetry fixes.

entry.title: LiteLLM — release
entry.summary: LiteLLM 1.104.2 is the latest stable release and backports the /v1/systemone and OpenAI-format /v1/decisions endpoints.

entry.title: Databricks Unity Gateway — feature
entry.summary: Unity Gateway external service policies (Beta) can send request and response content to a third-party guardrail vendor and block denied calls.

entry.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway — feature
entry.summary: Cloudflare launched a Web Search API in beta that runs through AI Gateway, with Ceramic.ai, Exa and Linkup as providers.

entry.title: agentgateway — release
entry.summary: agentgateway 1.6.0 adds more resilient LLM routing, built-in cost tracking and enables the AgentgatewayModel API by default.

entry.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway — feature
entry.summary: Cloudflare AI Gateway added Machine Payments (beta), letting clients pay for eligible requests over x402 from a stablecoin wallet.

entry.title: agentgateway — release
entry.summary: agentgateway 1.5.0 added API-key-scoped LLM budgets, native Gemini APIs, and guardrails on tool calls, with breaking JWT and token-count changes.
